info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Seatmaps-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Seat Map Retrieval API enables users to access the seat map information for various airline flights. This functionality is essential for travel agencies, booking platforms, and airline operators who need to display seating arrangements to customers during the booking process. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate comprehensive seat layout details, improving the user experience and facilitating informed decisions about flight choices. This API is particularly useful for enhancing visibility into available seating options and managing customer preferences effectively.

get.description: This endpoint fetches the seat map information for available flights, allowing users to view the layout and availability of seats for a specific flight.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the seat map for a specified flight. This includes essential parameters required for fetching the seat layout and availability.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the seat map for the specified flight.
